sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '2026-11-12') - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birth_datetime)) > 80 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (43531010)) AND co.condition_start_date <= DATE '2026-11-12') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (3016723)) AND m.value_as_number < 50 AND m.measurement_date <= DATE '2026-11-12');
